# Prepare SNP data for `SVDquartets`

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# awk '{print $1".aligned.sorted_"$1".aligned.sorted", $0}' astral_names.txt > species_tree.txt 
awk '{print $1}' species_tree.txt > keep.txt
awk '{print $3}' species_tree.txt > rename.txt

### subset VCF by samples for species tree inference & rename
bcftools view -S keep.txt /scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/bcftools/full_miss90_LD.vcf | \
    bcftools reheader -s rename.txt | \
    bcftools view -Oz -o /scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/svd/speciestree_miss90LD.vcf.gz

rm keep.txt
rm rename.txt

### convert to Nexus
vcf2phylip.py -i /scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/svd/speciestree_miss90LD.vcf.gz \
    --output-folder /scratch/tcm0036/distichus-ddRAD/brevirostris-project/phylo/svd/ \
    --output-prefix svd_miss90LD \
    -m 1 -n

cat taxonpartion.txt >> svd_miss90LD.min1.nexus 
```

## `TAXPARTITION` block to Nexus file

        BEGIN SETS;
        taxpartition distichus.species =
                A.websteri     : 1-2,
                A.marron  : 3-5,
                A.caudalis  : 6-7,
                A.brevirostris : 8-15,
                A.d.Tiburon  : 16-19,
                A.d.favillarum   : 20-23,
                A.d.dominicensisWest : 24-27,
                A.d.Bahamas  : 28-32,
                A.d.dominicensisEast  : 33-36,
                A.d.ignigularisWest   : 37-39,
                A.d.ignigularisEast  : 40-42,
                A.d.propsej  : 43-45,
                A.d.ravitergum : 46-49;
        END;

## PAUP* control block 

`svdquartets_run.nex`: 

        BEGIN PAUP;
                execute svd_miss90LD.min1.nexus;
                
                svdquartets partition=distichus.species evalQuartets=all bootstrap=standard nreps=1000 nthreads=auto treeFile=svd_bootstrap.trees;
                
                savetrees file=svdquartets_tree.tre format=newick root=no supportValues=nodeLabels;
                
                quit;
        END;


# Run `PAUP*`
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda activate phyloenv
sbatch --job-name paup \
        --partition jro0014_amd \
        --cpus-per-task=8 \
        --mem 80G \
        --time 72:00:00 \
        --wrap="paup4a168_centos64 -n svdquartets_run.nex > svdquartets.log"
```

# Summarize bootstrap trees
```{bash, eval=FALSE}
sumtrees --summary-target=mcct --support-as-labels --percentages --decimals=0 --force-unrooted --output-tree-filepath=svd_mcct.tre svd_bootstrap.trees
```

# Visualize the point estimate tree
```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
library(ape)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)

tree <- read.tree("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/phylo/svdquartets/svdquartets_tree.tre")
plot.phylo(tree, cex = 1.2, show.node.label = TRUE)

brev_grp <- c("A.brevirostris", "A.marron", "A.caudalis", "A.websteri")
tree2 <- root(tree, outgroup = brev_grp, resolve.root = TRUE)
plot.phylo(tree2, cex = 1.2)

tip_colors <- setNames(c(
        "#000000", # websteri
        "#756CA3", # marron
        "#93BBBD", # caudalis
        "#202AC2", # brevirostris
        "#DB8CA3", # Tiburon 
        "#FFE684", # favillarum
        "#B83B15", # west dom
        "#7B3F8A", # Bahamas
        "#2E4766", # east dom
        "#28C3D1", # east ignigularis
        "#30C7AB", # west ignigularis
        "#BDA425", # properus
        "#BBDB8B" # ravitergum
        ),
        c("A. websteri", "A. marron", "A. caudalis", "A. brevirostris",
        "A. distichus - Tiburon", 'A. d. favillarum', "A. d. dominicensis - West",
        "A. distichus - Bahamas", "A. d. dominicensis - East", "A. d. ignigularis - West",
        "A. d. ignigularis - East", "A. d. properus/sejunctus", "A. d. ravitergum")
)
tree2$tip.label <- c("A. websteri", "A. marron", "A. caudalis", "A. brevirostris",
        "A. distichus - Tiburon", 'A. d. favillarum', "A. d. dominicensis - West",
        "A. distichus - Bahamas", "A. d. dominicensis - East", "A. d. ignigularis - West",
        "A. d. ignigularis - East", "A. d. properus/sejunctus", "A. d. ravitergum")

par(family = "Helvetica") 
plot.phylo(tree2, cex = 1.8, label.offset = 0.2, show.node.label = TRUE)
tiplabels(pch = 16, col = tip_colors)

ggtree(tree2) + 
        geom_tiplab(size = 6, offset = 0.2, family = "Helvetica", fontface = "italic") +
        geom_nodelab(size = 4, hjust = -0.2) +  # Show node labels
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        theme(legend.position = "none",
                axis.line.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
        hexpand(.3)
# ggsave("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/figures/SVDquartets_species_tree.pdf",
#     width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```

## Visualize the maximum clade credibility (MCC) tree
```{r}
mcc <- read.nexus("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/phylo/svdquartets/svd_mcct.tre")
plot.phylo(mcc)

### sumtrees doesn't provide branch lengths so we'll just get rid of those
### our focus is on the topology and % of bootstraps showing support
mcc$edge.length <- NULL

mcc2 <- root(mcc, outgroup = brev_grp, resolve.root = TRUE)

tip_colors <- setNames(c(
        "#000000", # websteri
        "#202AC2", # brevirostris
        "#756CA3", # marron
        "#93BBBD", # caudalis
        "#BBDB8B", # ravitergum
        "#B83B15", # west dom
        "#DB8CA3", # Tiburon 
        "#FFE684", # favillarum
        "#7B3F8A", # Bahamas
        "#2E4766", # east dom
        "#BDA425", # properus
        "#30C7AB", # west ignigularis
        "#28C3D1" # east ignigularis
        ),
        c("A. websteri", "A. brevirostris", "A. marron", "A. caudalis",
        "A. d. ravitergum", "A. d. dominicensis - West", "A. distichus - Tiburon", 'A. d. favillarum',
        "A. distichus - Bahamas", "A. d. dominicensis - East", "A. d. properus/sejunctus", "A. d. ignigularis - West", "A. d. ignigularis - East")
)
mcc2$tip.label <- c("A. websteri", "A. brevirostris", "A. marron", "A. caudalis",
        "A. d. ravitergum", "A. d. dominicensis - West", "A. distichus - Tiburon", 'A. d. favillarum',
        "A. distichus - Bahamas", "A. d. dominicensis - East", "A. d. properus/sejunctus", "A. d. ignigularis - West", "A. d. ignigularis - East")

ggtree(mcc2) + 
        geom_tiplab(size = 6, offset = 0.2, family = "Helvetica", fontface = "italic") +
        geom_nodelab(size = 4, hjust = -0.2) +  # Show node labels
        geom_tippoint(aes(color = label), size = 5) +
        scale_color_manual(values = tip_colors) +
        theme(legend.position = "none",
                axis.line.x = element_blank(),
                axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
        hexpand(.3)
ggsave("/Users/tannermyers/Dropbox/Distichus_Project/brevirostris-ms/figures/SVDquartets_mcc_tree.pdf",
    width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
```
